title: Understanding Decision Thresholds
text: When you lower the decision threshold in a logistic regression model, you are essentially making it easier for the model to predict the positive class. Think about how this might affect the number of predictions for "Kendrick."

title: Impact on Predictions
text: Consider what happens to the model's sensitivity and specificity when the threshold is lowered. How does this change the balance between false positives and false negatives?

title: Threshold and Prediction Frequency
text: If the threshold is lowered from $$0.5$$ to $$0.3$$, will the model predict "Kendrick" more often, less often, or the same amount?
